protocol.dataset: SKAB v0.9: 34 runs, 8 signals at 1 Hz
protocol.split: SKAB protocol: first 400 s of each run = normal-only baseline, remainder = test
protocol.pointwise: SKAB binary metric aggregated over all runs (F1 = TP/(TP+(FP+FN)/2))
protocol.events: fault detected if an alarm is active inside its labelled window; delay from window start; an alarm that never touches a fault is one false-alarm event
protocol.tuning: nested leave-one-family-out (valve1 / valve2 / other) over a 288-setting grid

line_simulation.label: SIMULATED: Monte-Carlo average under editable assumptions, not a measurement
